parts.label: Stage 1 engine cluster
parts.problem: Provides primary propulsion for stage one and transfers thrust into the vehicle structure.
parts.process: Printed chambers and injectors are assembled, instrumented, and accepted by hot fire.

parts.label: Stage 1 thrust structure
parts.problem: Transfers engine loads into the stage while maintaining alignment across engine interfaces.
parts.process: Printed as an integrated structure, stress relieved, machined, inspected, and proof tested.

parts.label: Stage 1 fuel tank
parts.problem: Stores stage one fuel within the required structural, pressure, and thermal boundaries.
parts.process: Wire additive barrel and domes are machined, joined, inspected, proof tested, and leak tested.

parts.label: Stage 1 oxidizer tank
parts.problem: Stores stage one oxidizer within the required structural, pressure, and thermal boundaries.
parts.process: Wire additive barrel and domes are machined, joined, inspected, proof tested, and leak tested.

parts.label: Stage 1 intertank
parts.problem: Carries loads and maintains alignment between the stage one propellant tanks.
parts.process: Printed barrel features are machined and joined between the two stage one tank sections.

parts.label: Stage 1 propellant feedlines
parts.problem: Routes fuel and oxidizer from the tanks to the stage one engine cluster.
parts.process: Purchased tube stock is formed, welded, cleaned, inspected, and proof tested in-house.

parts.label: Interstage
parts.problem: Joins the two stages, carries ascent loads, and supports the separation interface.
parts.process: A large-format printed barrel is stress relieved and machined at both vehicle interfaces.

parts.label: Stage 2 engine
parts.problem: Provides upper-stage propulsion and the performance needed to complete payload insertion.
parts.process: Printed chamber and injector hardware is assembled with the vacuum nozzle and hot-fire accepted.

parts.label: Stage 2 fuel tank
parts.problem: Stores upper-stage fuel within tighter mass, pressure, and dimensional constraints.
parts.process: Thin-wall additive sections are machined, joined, inspected, proof tested, and leak tested.

parts.label: Stage 2 oxidizer tank
parts.problem: Stores upper-stage oxidizer within tighter mass, pressure, and dimensional constraints.
parts.process: Thin-wall additive sections are machined, joined, inspected, proof tested, and leak tested.

parts.label: Avionics bay
parts.problem: Houses the flight computers, power distribution, communications, and vehicle instrumentation.
parts.process: Purchased flight electronics are integrated with in-house harnesses, software, and sensors.

parts.label: Flight termination system
parts.problem: Provides an independent commanded safety function during flight operations.
parts.process: Qualified termination hardware is purchased, integrated, functionally tested, and independently verified.

parts.label: Payload adapter
parts.problem: Carries the payload and provides its structural and separation interface to stage two.
parts.process: Purchased separation hardware is inspected, fit checked, integrated, and verified to interface requirements.

parts.label: Payload fairing
parts.problem: Protects the payload through ground handling and atmospheric ascent before separation.
parts.process: Printed frames and composite skins are assembled, inspected, and separation tested.

parts.label: Payload
parts.problem: Represents the customer payload and its governed vehicle interfaces in this synthetic program.
parts.process: Customer-supplied payload interfaces are verified before mechanical and electrical integration.

parts.label: Additive manufacturing cell
parts.problem: Produces the large-format additive structures represented in this sanitized program seed.
parts.process: The synthetic printer cell is calibrated, qualified, monitored, and maintained as production equipment.

parts.label: Production gantries
parts.problem: Moves and positions large hardware safely through manufacturing and integration operations.

statusHistory.note: Synthetic legacy path retired after capability consolidation.

parts.process: Production handling equipment is installed, commissioned, inspected, and maintained on a controlled schedule.

parts.label: Quality inspection scanner
parts.problem: Captures dimensional and surface evidence used for nonconformance and acceptance decisions.
parts.process: Inspection equipment is calibrated against synthetic standards before controlled scans are accepted.

parts.label: Test instrumentation sensors
parts.problem: Measures vehicle and facility behavior during manufacturing, qualification, and acceptance tests.
parts.process: Purchased sensors are calibrated, mapped to channels, installed, and checked before test.

parts.label: Test stand
parts.problem: Supports controlled engine and stage testing with traceable configuration and instrumentation.
parts.process: The synthetic stand, plumbing, controls, and instrumentation are configured and verified before use.

parts.label: Ground support equipment
parts.problem: Provides the mechanical, electrical, and fluid services needed to handle and operate the vehicle.
parts.process: Support equipment is configured, inspected, maintained, and checked against the test or launch configuration.

parts.label: Propellant farm
parts.problem: Stores and conditions propellants for controlled transfer during test and launch operations.
parts.process: Storage vessels, transfer systems, and sampling points are commissioned and maintained as site infrastructure.

parts.label: Range safety system
parts.problem: Provides the monitored safety boundary and command path required for flight operations.
parts.process: Safety communications, tracking, and command paths are configured, tested, and independently verified.

parts.label: Flight operations console
parts.problem: Provides an integrated operating position for readiness, test, and flight decisions.
parts.process: Console hardware, displays, communications, and approved procedures are configured for each operation.
